page_title: ATM 3-0 RAY | Atletico Madrid v Rayo Vallecano 24/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' The referee points to the corner flag and Rayo Vallecano will take a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the top left corner, but Jan Oblak thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
88' Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Pablo Fuertes blows for a foul.
87' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
84' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alvaro Garcia departs the field of play to be replaced by Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano).
81' The corner from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by Augusto Batalla.
81' Rodrigo de Paul will be replaced by Koke (Atl. Madrid).
81' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Conor Gallagher will be replaced by Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Javi Galan leaves the pitch and Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
79' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
79' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Pablo Fuertes ignores the protests.
77' 3 - 0 Goal! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is teed up on the edge of the box by Antoine Griezmann, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 3:0.
76' Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch because Randy Nteka simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
74' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
73' Ball possession – 41:59.
70' A shot from the edge of the box by Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
68' The substitution has been made. Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) has replaced Oscar Valentin.
68' That will be all from Unai Lopez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
68' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) is replaced by Pep Chavarria.
67' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) replacing Giuliano Simeone.
66' The referee blows his whistle, Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
66' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) will miss the next game.
66' Pablo Fuertes shows a yellow card to Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
65' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.

64' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) makes a yard for himself and attempts to endanger the goalkeeper with a long-range shot. His great effort, however, goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.

63' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar.
61' Substitution. Alexander Sorloth makes his way off the pitch and Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) comes on as his replacement.
57' Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle and signals a foul after Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) brought his opponent down.
55' Looks like Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
55' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' A crossfield pass from Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
52' Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
51' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
49' The attendance is 49410.
47' Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle as Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. It's a free kick to Rayo Vallecano in a dangerous position.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' The linesman signals that Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' 2 - 0 Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
44' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano). Pablo Fuertes saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
43' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
41' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
39' It's a throw-in for Atl. Madrid.

36' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
35' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
34' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Pablo Fuertes saw the whole situation. Atl. Madrid will take a free kick near the side line.

30' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
28' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Jan Oblak makes a great save to stop his effort.
26' 0:4 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
24' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
23' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
19' The ball is behind the sideline. Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) takes a throw-in.
17' Rayo Vallecano hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
15' A player from Rayo Vallecano commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
13' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Augusto Batalla comes off his line to intercept.

10' That was close by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
9' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
8' Augusto Batalla pulls off a great save to deny Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
6' A decent cross gives Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.
4' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
3' 1 - 0 Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) latches onto a brilliant cross and produces a perfect header that goes inside the left post to give the goalkeeper no chance!
